# Privacy Policy

*Last updated: 18 November 2026*

## 1. Introduction
Welcome to The Digital Duck Pond.

I respect your privacy and aim to keep this website as privacy-friendly as possible. This privacy policy explains how personal data may be processed when you visit this website or contact me.

## 2. Website hosting and server logs
This website is hosted using GitHub Pages, a static website hosting service provided by GitHub. When you visit this website, technical information is transmitted to the hosting infrastructure so that the requested pages and resources can be delivered.

Depending on the hosting infrastructure, this information may include:

- Your IP address
- The date and time of your request
- The requested page or resource
- Browser and device information
- Technical information necessary for delivering and securing the website

**Purpose:** Delivering the website, maintaining technical functionality, and protecting the hosting infrastructure against misuse.  
**Hosting provider:** GitHub  

Further information is available in the [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## 3. Cookies and browser storage
This website is designed to operate without advertising cookies or visitor tracking. I do not intentionally use cookies for advertising, behavioral profiling, or analytics.

## 5. Analytics and tracking
I do not currently use Google Analytics, advertising pixels, or other visitor-tracking services. I do not create personal visitor profiles or use browsing information for targeted advertising.

This statement does not cover technical security logging performed independently by the hosting provider.

## 6. Locally hosted resources
The website uses locally hosted resources where practical, including fonts, stylesheets, scripts, and images. This reduces the need for visitors' browsers to request resources directly from external providers.

Locally hosted resources are generally delivered through the website's hosting infrastructure.

## 7. External links
This website contains links to external services, including GitHub, Printables, and social media platforms. These links are provided to make additional information, project files, and related content accessible.

Ordinary external links do not automatically load content from the destination website. When you follow an external link, the destination provider may process personal data according to its own privacy policy.

I recommend reviewing the privacy information of the relevant provider.

## 9. International data transfers
Some service providers used in connection with this website may process personal data outside the European Economic Area.

## 11. Changes to this privacy policy

I may update this privacy policy when the website's functionality, hosting arrangements, or data processing activities change.

The date at the top of this page indicates when the policy was last updated.
